name: Hanei Nora
source:
A girl who recently arrived in this town, with something mysterious about her.
She is quiet; her expression rarely changes, and it's hard to tell what she is thinking.

She carries a quiet air and an enigmatic aura.

[Translated from [url=https://shiratamaco.com/kazeshiro/]official website[/url]]
